Subject: Your consumer complaint matter - C.C. No. 825/2019

Dear Ms. Ranade,

Thank you for meeting us on 06/07/2019 about your dispute with Skyline Realty. As we understand it, the builder never obtained the occupancy certificate.

Our advice is to seek a full refund with interest because the builder failed to obtain the occupancy certificate. Please collect the builder-buyer agreement, payment receipts and the municipal reply on the occupancy certificate and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹3,24,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
